objective: Prevent Unity texture compression from destroying the subtle 7.9 m neutral facade anti-repetition signal before formal 4K render evidence.

finding.sourceAmplitude: The approved macro field spans sRGB 0.49 to 0.516, only about 6.63 8-bit code values peak-to-peak.
finding.priorRisk: Source-pixel SHA-256/pixel QA proves the PNG is correct, but the existing generator requested CompressedHQ at import. Platform block compression can quantize or spatially block a low-amplitude field after source validation, so source correctness alone did not prove runtime texel fidelity.
finding.resolution: Added a preparation upgrade that forces the benchmark macro field to Uncompressed import, disables Crunch and Standalone overrides, preserves 1024 resolution/mipmaps/Repeat/Trilinear/aniso>=8, reasserts the state after source imports, and keeps formal pre-cull validation read-only and fail-closed.

substantiveCommits.message: Add facade macro import precision contract

verification.unityApiVerification: Unity 6 documentation confirms TextureImporterCompression.Uncompressed disables texture compression and EditorUserBuildSettings.overrideTextureCompression can override individual import settings; formal guard rejects ForceFastCompressor.
verification.branchComparison: 2 commits ahead / 0 behind startHead before run record; merge-base remains startHead.

failureInjectionPlan: set TextureImporter.textureCompression to CompressedHQ -> formal capture must fail
enable Crunch compression -> formal capture must fail
set Standalone platform override -> formal capture must fail
reduce maxTextureSize below 1024 -> formal capture must fail
disable mipmaps or set Bilinear filtering -> formal capture must fail
reduce anisotropy below 8 -> formal capture must fail
set EditorUserBuildSettings.overrideTextureCompression to ForceFastCompressor -> formal capture must fail
